name: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd
title: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd - 544021 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue INR 998 cr (+19%) and EBITDA margin 17.6%, but Q4 flattered by INR 44 cr one-off storage income; management guides ASK timing mismatch margin dip and lower revenue next year.

triggers.label: Storage income INR 44 cr is non-recurring
triggers.quote: No, this is for 2.5-3 years. This will not be the run rate for next year. Next year will be a lower than this

triggers.label: ASK rollout 44 of 190 live
triggers.quote: 44 Aadhaar Seva Kendras across 20 states and union territories

triggers.label: Processing charges guided 35-38%
triggers.quote: I guess processing charges will remain in this range only between 35% to 38%

guidance.quote: Our plan is to go live with all 1 90 Aadhaar Seva Kendras by September or by October 2026 max.
We endeavour to improve our margins significantly in next 2-3 years.
this revenue should constitute about 25% of our total revenue in 2 to 3 years

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue inflated by one-off storage income
red_flags.quote: Revenue for this quarter also include INR 44 crores on account of storage charges.

red_flags.label: Management declines segment and project margin disclosure
red_flags.quote: we do not have segmental reporting , we only declare results on consolidated basis.

red_flags.label: PAN 2.0 distribution model unresolved
red_flags.quote: We'll have to wait and watch after 12-18 months, we need to see how distribution pans out in new PAN ecosystem

evasions.quote: I would not be able to provide you EBITDA business-wise.
I would not be able to disclose, Bajrang, the margin for each project
I don't think we have these numbers.

evasions.topic: Q1 FY27 margin dip from ASK
evasions.quote: I would not be able to comment on this right now
